headline: US Dollar Reaches 12-Month High of 5.93 Reais With Brazilian Markets Shut
summary: The US dollar reached 5.93 Brazilian reals, its highest level in 12 months, as local financial markets remained closed for the Black Consciousness Day holiday.
why: A weakening real increases Brazil's import costs and fiscal strain, influencing future monetary policy decisions by Banco Central do Brasil.

impacts.name: Brazilian Real
impacts.why: The Brazilian real weakened as the US dollar hit 5.93, a 12-month high.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The real depreciated to a 12-month low against the US dollar amid thin holiday liquidity and strong global dollar momentum.
